summary: All four files contain substantial formal mathematical content: definitions, structures, typeclasses, inductive types, and theorems with proofs. Frame.lean defines belief-commitment frames with KD45/K45 modal logic, restrictCommitment updates, and sincerity/competence frame conditions with transfer theorems. CommonGround.lean formalizes Stalnakerian common ground as filters with HasCommonGround/HasAssertion typeclasses and assertion history theorems. Gameboard/Basic.lean defines dialogue gameboard operations (pushQud, addFact, downdateQud) with NonResolveCond and common ground/issue instances. Gameboard/Defs.lean provides the foundational structures: GrammaticalDomain, Gameboard.Domain, IllocutionaryAct, SubUtterance, LocutionaryProposition, InformationStructure, and Gameboard. None are pure import aggregators, generated data, or stubs.
